title: Kiritani Haruka — Happy Birthday!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy
Class 1-C - Doorway

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Hm...? Why do things seem so lively this morning? Not many students are usually here this early.)
Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good morning.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Good morning, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mooorning♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What's going on? Why are you all here so early...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
That's because today's your birthday, Haruka♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Everyone, ready! One...! Two...!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh wow...! You did all this for me...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Everyone, thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Looks like our surprise was a big success, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup♪ Ichi, everybody, thank you guys so much for helping out!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: No, we really wanted to celebrate Haruka's birthday too!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Now, it's present time!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, presents?

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: I got you some penguin-themed pens and pencils! I really hope you like them!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, there's a rockhopper penguin on this one! Hehe. Its eyes are so cute. I promise to cherish it!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: I got you some cute penguin candies! Here!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh... These are really cute too!
They're adorable. I'm not sure I can eat them.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
Haruka!
I got you a present too!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Me too! Me too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (This is incredible! So much penguin merchandise that I've never seen before!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They must've spent so much time looking for these while keeping in mind how much I like penguins...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you all so much!
I'll treasure all of these adorable penguins!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Haruka, it's your birthday?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, Otori.
Yes, it is. My classmates were just throwing me a surprise party...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wanna join us Emu?
We just got started here, so let's party together♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay♪ Lemme see... I have some little chocolates, some cookies and...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Here you go, Haruka! Happy birthday♪ I brought lots of snacks today, so you can have some☆

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you, but are you sure?
You won't have any left for yourself if you give me this much.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, you can have them♪
I still have plenty left in my bag☆

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, that's good. In that case, I gladly accept and will have some later.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Great☆

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Hehe. They gave me so many presents that I'm having a hard time holding onto all of them.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (My fans were always there to celebrate my birthday when I was still in ASRUN...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But I didn't expect so many people to celebrate me for who I am instead of Haruka Kiritani “the idol”.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I had the same thought during the Sports Festival, but going back to school was a great decision...)
Lunch Break

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Hi, Kiritani! Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Hehe. Everyone's been wishing me a happy birthday even when I'm just passing through. They must've heard what happened in my class.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting, Minori.
And hello to you both, Hinomori, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was just about to go buy lunch is all.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, before I forget...
Happy birthday, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you!
I'm guessing you heard what happened in my class.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, we could hear Saki from here.
She also kept mentioning that she wanted to throw you a surprise party during band practice.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see...
That means she was planning this for quite a while. I'll need to thank her later.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I can't express just how much I appreciate Tenma and Hoshino treating me like a regular classmate since I started going back to school...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Tenma inviting me to help with the Sports Festival even helped me get to know everyone else better.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I really can't thank them enough.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, um... Kiritani...
H-Happy birthday! Here you are...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Azusawa, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-Also...! Do you happen to be free after school today?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: After school?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We're supposed to do a birthday fan meeting in SEKAI later...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I do have plans but they're not too urgent, so I should be fine.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Really?! Thank goodness!
I'll stop by your class once school's out!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, I'll be waiting.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Now, Minori, shall we head up to the rooftop?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, thanks for waiting!
Alright, it's time to start Haruka's birthday stream!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Happy birthday, Haruka!>
<Happy birthday♪>
<Happy B-Day! Haruka forever!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! L-Look at all the comments!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, this is great! Sadly, we don't have enough time to go through all of them...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It means they care about you just that much, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I've been Haruka's fan since her debut!>
<Thank you for becoming an idol again!>
<Please be an idol forever and ever!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: All these thoughtful words... Thank you, I couldn't be happier. I promise to read through all of your comments later!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I get to connect with my fans again. It really feels like I've returned to being an idol.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And I'm able to celebrate my birthday with them like this because...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, let's move on to our first segment!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Ready, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm ready. Leave it to me!
